fieldNotes.representations: codec-manifest.v1 declares representations inside each trait (`traits[].representations`). Each codec unit keeps the per-trait detail and the flattened union; nothing is invented for a manifest that declares no traits.
fieldNotes.packageExportSymbols: Symbols come from a static read of the exported entry module and its relative `export *` chain. `unresolvedReexports` lists cross-package or unresolvable re-exports; such units stay depth: shallow.
fieldNotes.runtimeCapability: Runtime/RTS units mirror exported surface, not proven user capability; every one is depth: shallow until the semantic registry assigns obligation and evidence.
fieldNotes.multiverse: UV/Multiverse units are path-derived only (family, artifact, format) so that prose edits inside a specification do not move the inventory.
fieldNotes.cliDepth: The legacy CLI contract is a static `as const` catalog, so commands, positional arguments, option kinds and enumerated values are fully extracted (depth: resolved).
